title: Network Effect Decomposition for Causal Effect Estimation under Network Interference
abstract: arXiv:2611.07879v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Estimating causal effects from observational network data requires accounting for both individual treatment and neighborhood exposure. Existing outcome models commonly incorporate these intervention variables into a joint predictor and estimate causal effects through prediction contrasts, leaving the corresponding response components implicit. We propose the $\underline{N}$etwork $\underline{E}$ffect $\underline{D}$ecomposition $\underline{Net}$work (NEDNet), which parameterizes the conditional outcome response as a query-invariant pre-treatment baseline plus separate treatment- and exposure-response pathways. Path-specific neighborhood contextualization supplies local pre-treatment information to the two pathways. We characterize the fitted response through a unique reference-normalized decomposition, which is equivalent to a zero mixed treatment--exposure contrast. translated_title: 网络效应分解：用于网络干扰下的因果效应估计
translated_abstract: 从观测网络数据中估计因果效应，需要同时考虑个体的处理和邻域暴露。现有的结果模型通常将这些干预变量合并到一个联合预测器中，并通过预测对比来估计因果效应，而相应的响应成分则是隐式的。我们提出了网络效应分解网络（NEDNet），它将条件结果响应参数化为一个与查询无关的处理前基线，加上相互独立的处理响应通路和暴露响应通路。路径特定的邻域上下文化机制为这两个通路提供局部的处理前信息。我们通过一个唯一的、参考归一化的分解来刻画拟合的响应，该分解等价于一个零混合处理-暴露对比。在基于BlogCatalog等数据集构建的半合成基准上的实验（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出NEDNet网络，将网络干扰下的结果响应分解为查询无关的处理前基线以及相互独立的处理响应通路和暴露响应通路，从而在观测网络数据上实现更准确的因果效应估计。
